name: p2e
description: P2E authoring and execution workflows for Codex, backed by the P2E MCP. Includes bootstrap (new + onboarding modes), add-story, update-story, work-on-next, ship-batch (heavyweight release-batch with 360° verify + per-story PR + review + roll-up), cut-release (PR-gated release flow with authoritative version detection + optional story closeout), sync-labels, sync, bind, manage-uxo, archaeology, fix, and verify-story. Aligned with the P2E Patton v3 Flow/Foundation model.

interface.shortDescription: Route P2E story-map work from Codex
interface.longDescription: Use P2E in Codex through a plain-language router and explicit workflow aliases for bootstrap (new + onboarding modes), add-story, update-story, work-on-next, ship-batch (heavyweight release-batch orchestrator), label reconciliation, drift sync, repo binding, UXO management, repo archaeology, uproot-and-replace bug fixing, and end-to-end story verification with a rich-HTML UAT report.
